promotions.title: Come Back Gift: Free 15-Minute Thai Foot Massage
promotions.detail: Book your next appointment with us directly, either at the desk before you leave or by WhatsApp, for any visit up to 31 January 2027. On that visit you get a free 15-minute Thai foot massage, or a 15-minute back and shoulder add-on, together with your treatment. One per client per visit.
